options.note: Use 和 between the two direction phrases: 以東和以西.

items.sub: Choose a model description for a country with different food habits on either side of a mountain region.

sentence.traditional: 我們國家的山區以東和以西的飲食習慣不太一樣。
sentence.simplified: 我们国家的山区以东和以西的饮食习惯不太一样。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā de shānqū yǐ dōng hé yǐ xī de yǐnshí xíguàn bú tài yíyàng.
sentence.english: In our country, food habits east and west of the mountain region differ somewhat.

sentence.traditional: 我們國家的山區以西和以東的飲食習慣不太一樣。
sentence.simplified: 我们国家的山区以西和以东的饮食习惯不太一样。
sentence.pinyin: Wǒmen guójiā de shānqū yǐ xī hé yǐ dōng de yǐnshí xíguàn bú tài yíyàng.
sentence.english: In our country, food habits west and east of the mountain region differ somewhat.

repairs.note: 向 indicates an orientation or movement, whereas 以 defines a regional boundary.
